partnerRpcs.name: submit_partner_application
partnerRpcs.signature: (p_partner_type text, p_legal_name text, p_trade_name text, p_contact_email text, p_kvk text DEFAULT NULL, p_vat text DEFAULT NULL, p_phone text DEFAULT NULL)
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 SIGNATURE CHANGE — p_partner_type ('INDIVIDUAL' | 'BUSINESS') is now the FIRST argument and the untyped 6-argument overload is dropped. INDIVIDUAL must not supply p_kvk; BUSINESS requires a company name and an 8-digit p_kvk. Leaves the profile PENDING and never sets ACTIVE.

partnerRpcs.name: review_partner_application
partnerRpcs.note: rc.6 — OWNER/ADMIN staff via is_staff_admin() + require_aal2() before approve/reject mutation. Approval records staff_approved_at/by and then attempts activation; partner stays PENDING when checklist incomplete. Approval alone never writes ACTIVE.

partnerRpcs.name: reactivate_partner
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 — grandfathered pre-rc.5 partners keep the rc.4 restore; every other partner must pass partner_activation_checklist or the call raises ACTIVATION_DENIED.

partnerRpcs.name: activate_partner_profile
partnerRpcs.signature: (p_partner_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text, p_partner_code text DEFAULT NULL)
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — OWNER/ADMIN + AAL2 + reason + idempotency. Delegates to partner_try_activate; an incomplete checklist raises ACTIVATION_DENIED:<code> and nothing is written.

partnerRpcs.name: accept_partner_agreement
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — the calling partner accepts one current agreement version. Idempotent per (partner, version). Bodies are placeholders pending legal review.

partnerRpcs.name: partner_activation_checklist
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — fixed-shape activation readiness report. Readable by staff or by the partner for their own profile. Diagnostic only: never an authorization source.

partnerRpcs.name: partner_try_activate
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff-gated; the only writer of an ACTIVE partner profile. Not exposed to partners.

partnerRpcs.name: partner_is_valid_kvk
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — format-only helper: TRUE iff the trimmed value is exactly 8 digits. Never used to infer partner type.

partnerRpcs.name: staff_set_partner_compliance_fixture
partnerRpcs.signature: (p_partner_id uuid, p_age_status text DEFAULT NULL, p_identity_status text DEFAULT NULL, p_business_status text DEFAULT NULL, p_payout_status text DEFAULT NULL)
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — STAGING ONLY synthetic verification fixtures. Raises FEATURE_DISABLED unless partner_compliance_fixtures is enabled. Never changes status or payout_eligible. Must stay disabled in production.

partnerRpcs.name: verify_partner_identity_directory_rc5_contracts
partnerRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — presence, hardening, activation-boundary and flag checks for the partner identity + admin directory detail surface.

partnerRpcs.name: verify_partner_approval_aal2_rc6_contracts
partnerRpcs.note: rc.6 NEW — AAL2 presence/order checks for review_partner_application plus sibling privileged RPC AAL2 audit.

partnerRpcs.name: verify_admin_rpc_schema_stamps_rc6
partnerRpcs.note: rc.6 — proves admin/directory/checklist schema_version stamps equal 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

customerPortalRpcs.name: list_portal_support_ticket_replies
customerPortalRpcs.signature: (p_ticket_id uuid, p_limit int DEFAULT 50, p_cursor timestamptz DEFAULT NULL)
customerPortalRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — replies for one ticket. Staff see internal notes; active members of the ticket's organization see public replies only; everyone else is FORBIDDEN. Keyset paging on created_at DESC, id DESC.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_list_partners
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 — additive keys: partner_type, type_classification_status, verification and payout-profile statuses, legacy_activation_grandfathered. Still no contact details and no balances. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_security_status
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.6 — unchanged rc.4/rc.5 shape with schema_version bumped to 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_product
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff product detail. cost_cents, margins and supplier data are never returned. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_partner
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff partner detail including the live activation_checklist. No email address and no balances. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_customer
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff customer detail with counters only. No email, phone, VAT/KvK or address. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_project
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff project detail. Related records are exposed as counts only. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_quote
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff quote detail with at most 50 line items. customer_note is never returned. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_invoice
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff invoice detail. Read-only; no payment or provider fields are exposed or mutated. rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

adminControlSurfaceRpcs.name: admin_get_appointment
adminControlSurfaceRpcs.note: rc.5 NEW — staff appointment detail. Never returns meeting_link, attendee identities or internal notes. Reads are not gated by appointments_booking (that flag gates mutations). rc.6 stamp: schema_version 2026.07.29.partner-approval-aal2-rc6.

deprecatedAliases.name: transition_portal_support_ticket
deprecatedAliases.note: Temporary contract-drift alias for Mobile backend-contract.json short name. Prefer canonical _status.

accept_quote.note: Signatures differ; Mobile must call accept_portal_quote(p_quote_id, p_expected_version, p_selected_optional_item_ids).

register_partner_lead.note: Param names differ (dedupe_key vs campaign); map in Mobile client. Always pass all eight arguments: the 7-argument compat wrapper is ambiguous with the 8-argument form.

submit_partner_application.note: rc.5 BREAKING — p_partner_type is now the first argument. Mobile must collect INDIVIDUAL vs BUSINESS explicitly, must not send a KvK for INDIVIDUAL, and must send an 8-digit KvK for BUSINESS. Expect VALIDATION_FAILED otherwise.

approve_partner_application.note: Owner uses review_partner_application(id, approve, reason, notes). rc.6: requires AAL2. Approval no longer activates the partner — read partner_activation_checklist to explain the remaining blockers.

reject_partner_application.note: rc.6 — maps to review_partner_application(..., false, ...). Requires AAL2.

request_commission_payout.note: Owner model is amount_cents + idempotency_key (ledger liability), not commission uuid[]. Payout mutations remain policy-gated.

admin_convert_lead.note: Sale creates PENDING commission; approve_partner_commission posts liability.

admin_reply_support_ticket.note: Public replies. Internal notes use add_portal_support_internal_note (staff + support_internal_notes_rpc flag).

admin_list_support_replies.note: rc.5 — staff calls see is_internal = true rows; customer sessions never do. Do not build a client-side internal/public filter.

list_ticket_messages.note: rc.5 — customer-facing paging over the same RPC. Server enforces the internal-note exclusion.

reactivate_partner.note: rc.5 — may raise ACTIVATION_DENIED for partners that are not grandfathered.

activate_partner.note: rc.5 — OWNER/ADMIN + AAL2 only. Partners cannot activate themselves; expect FORBIDDEN. Surface ACTIVATION_DENIED:<code> as the remaining onboarding step.

partner_onboarding_status.note: rc.5 — a partner may read their own checklist. Render missing[] as the onboarding to-do list; never treat can_activate as an authorization decision.

accept_partner_terms.note: rc.5 — resolve the current version from partner_agreement_versions for the partner's required_agreement_type. Bodies carry legal_review_status = REQUIRED and must not be presented as final terms.

admin_get_product.note: rc.5 — staff only. cost_cents and supplier data are absent by design; do not expect them.

admin_get_partner.note: rc.5 — staff only. Includes activation_checklist for the partner detail screen.

admin_get_customer.note: rc.5 — staff only. Counters only; no contact details.

admin_get_project.note: rc.5 — staff only. Related records are counts; fetch detail through the dedicated RPCs.

admin_get_quote.note: rc.5 — staff only. items is capped at 50; honour items_truncated.

admin_get_appointment.note: rc.5 — staff only. meeting_link and attendee identities are never returned; notes_customer_safe is always null until a visibility column exists.

payoutMutationsMobilePolicy.reason: Payout execution/governance not separately authorized for Mobile day-1.

stagingOnlyRpcs.name: staff_set_partner_compliance_fixture
stagingOnlyRpcs.note: Fail-closed. Never enable in production; synthetic verification data only.
